verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents its own wallet infrastructure to 'receive, hold, split, and transfer funds' and lets platforms create unlimited wallets, so funds can be held per seller. Platform fees are mentioned only as monthly wiring to the platform's bank account. Reversal evidence covers chargebacks and refunds pulled from a wallet, not adjusting a split. missing for 10: explicit documentation of splitting one pay-in across multiple seller wallets, a per-transaction platform fee field or object, reversing or adjusting transfers and splits as first-class API objects, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split one charge among any set of parties — route funds to multiple sellers, take my cut, and reverse or adjust the split later, all as first-class API objects

citations.quote: Leverage Mangopay's wallet infrastructure to receive, hold, split, and transfer funds
Platforms can create an unlimited number of wallets to hold funds as long as needed.
Your fees are automatically wired to your bank account every month.
The funds are automatically deducted from this wallet and sent back to the user.
